name: elm-klar-tools
description: Development tools for the Klar Elm package. The package itself has no npm dependencies; see elm.json.

scripts.check:format: elm-format --validate src/ tests/ example/src/ example/tests/ apps/calendar/src/ apps/calendar/tests/
scripts.check:quick: npm run check:text && npm run check:classes && npm run check:icons && npm run check:documentation && npm run check:rules && npm run check:format && npm run check:gallery
scripts.check: npm run check:quick && npm test -- --workers 2 && npm run test:gallery && npm run test:compiler && npm run test:calendar-server && npm run calendar:test -- --workers 2 && npm run build:example && npm run test:browser && npm run check:example-imports
scripts.format: elm-format --yes src/ tests/ example/src/ example/tests/ apps/calendar/src/ apps/calendar/tests/ && node scripts/check-text.mjs --fix
